item.text: I’ll adjust the desktop accessibility/text scaling setting so text is larger across the system.

item.command: /bin/bash -lc 'gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.interface text-scaling-factor && gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.interface cursor-size && gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.a11y.applications screen-magnifier-enabled'

/bin/bash -lc 'gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.interface text-scaling-factor && gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.interface cursor-size && gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.a11y.applications screen-magnifier-enabled'

item.text: The current GNOME text scale is the default `1.0`. I’m raising it to a more readable level and leaving other accessibility tools available if needed.

item.command: /bin/bash -lc 'gsettings set org.gnome.desktop.interface text-scaling-factor 1.5 && gsettings set org.gnome.desktop.interface cursor-size 48 && gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.interface text-scaling-factor && gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.interface cursor-size'

item.text: I enlarged the system text to `1.5x` and increased the cursor size to make it easier to see.
